overrideReason: All 3 automated attempts hit '0/6 — not judged, a cheaper layer already failed' because pyproject.toml's pytest --basetemp pointed at .tmp/pytest, a directory that had acquired an ACL not even the interactive user's own takeown/icacls could reclaim (WinError 5 on every test-run teardown), turning 24 otherwise-passing tests into ERRORs and failing the test gate before any criterion was ever judged. Not a defect in this story's code. Fixed separately (pyproject.toml: --basetemp=.tmp/pytest2, commit 916b26a) - unrelated to this story's content, so kept out of its diff. With the environment fixed, verified all 6 criteria directly: C1-C3 and C6 by reading the already-committed code (attempt 3, commit c8e5c53) fresh against a clean environment; C4 and C5 required a real dispatched run, which additionally surfaced a genuine platform constraint - GitHub requires a workflow_dispatch/repository_dispatch-triggered workflow to exist on the default branch before it can be triggered by either mechanism (confirmed empirically: both a workflow_dispatch and a real repository_dispatch call against ingest-fast.yml on the feature branch returned 404/no-op). Owner approved landing ingest-fast.yml on main ahead of the rest of PRD-012 (commit 67ceeab) specifically to get this real evidence. Also discovered, and now fixed, that ingest-fast.yml's and ingest-medium.yml's dedicated Healthchecks.io secrets (HEALTHCHECK_URL_INGEST_FAST/MEDIUM) had never actually been created - ingest/heartbeat.py's _ping() silently swallows httpx.HTTPError (by design, so monitoring never overrides the real ingest result), so a missing secret produces a silent no-op ping rather than a visible failure. Owner created both Healthchecks.io checks and their secrets now exist.

results.note: ingest-fast.yml's `on:` block is exactly `repository_dispatch: types: [ingest-fast]` plus `workflow_dispatch:` - no `schedule:` key at all. Confirmed by direct file read against current HEAD.

tests/test_persist_board.py::test_fast_tier_entry_point_persists_only_fast_board_rows_and_pings_once calls heartbeat.main(['--tier','fast']) directly, exercising the real argparse -> run_ingestion -> run_pipeline -> run_scheduled_board -> run_all_assets chain (the same unmodified US-1201 filter), with only I/O boundaries mocked and every non-fast fetcher wired to raise if called.

ingest-fast.yml references HEALTHCHECK_URL_INGEST_FAST, distinct from every other tier's secret name. That secret now genuinely exists (owner created the Healthchecks.io check and provisioned the secret, 2026-09-27) - a real prerequisite this override caught and fixed, not just a code-level name check.

Real dispatched run: https://github.com/haz18zayour/crypto-data-live-platform/actions/runs/36316892830 (repository_dispatch, event_type=ingest-fast, on main, run id 36316892830), job 'ingest-fast' completed successfully in 1m46s. This is the actual dispatch entry point, exercised for real against live OKX vendors, not approximated locally.

The same real run (36316892830) is the measured wall-clock proof this criterion asks for: checkout + uv install + all 12 OKX calls + writes + heartbeat ping completed in 1m46s total, leaving roughly 3m14s of real, measured headroom under the 5-minute cadence - not an estimate.
`uv run pytest -q -m "not integration"` re-run fresh against current HEAD, after the basetemp fix: 282 passed, 48 deselected, exit 0. `uv run mypy ingest --strict` and `uv run ruff check` both clean.

note: All 6 criteria independently verified against current HEAD (c8e5c53 on feat/prd-012-cadence-split, plus ingest-fast.yml landed early on main at 67ceeab). This story's own path to done required fixing three things outside its own diff: a poisoned local pytest tmp directory blocking every attempt's test gate, a GitHub platform constraint requiring the workflow to exist on main before it could be dispatched at all, and two missing Healthchecks.io secrets that would have left the fast/medium tiers silently unmonitored in production. None of these were code defects in US-1204 itself, but all three needed to be found and fixed before this story's guarantee could be considered real rather than merely claimed.
